description: PostgreSQL 18 transaction-stable CURRENT_DATE with session timezones and indexed date predicates
sql: CREATE TABLE type_matrix_current_date (id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, value DATE UNIQUE);
INSERT INTO type_matrix_current_date VALUES ('today', CURRENT_DATE), ('tomorrow', CURRENT_DATE + 1);
SELECT id FROM type_matrix_current_date WHERE value = CURRENT_DATE;
SELECT CURRENT_DATE = CURRENT_DATE AS date_stable, now() = transaction_timestamp() AS transaction_stable, clock_timestamp() >= transaction_timestamp() AS clock_advances;
SELECT CURRENT_DATE = CURRENT_DATE AS kiritimati_stable, now() = transaction_timestamp() AS transaction_stable;
SELECT CURRENT_DATE = CURRENT_DATE AS adak_stable, now() = transaction_timestamp() AS transaction_stable;
